**A release candidate:** what 2.2.0 will be unless a blocker turns up. It ships inside
[HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.1), and
you can also install it on its own over 2.1.0 or 2.2.0-beta.1 (HMG-API 1.0.0 or later).

## What's new since 2.2.0-beta.1

- **Android Auto roundabouts go the right way round** with "Android Auto turns in the car's
  own format" on. US roundabouts were drawn clockwise; the way round now comes from the
  icon, not from Android Auto's side, so US and Canadian cars always get counterclockwise.
  Inside a roundabout the exit icon also stays with the setting off. Thanks to AwsomeFox
  (#19, #20).
- **"Recalculating…" on a reroute** with that setting on: a reroute of more than a second
  shows the cluster's own "Recalculating" until the new route's first turn, instead of a
  stale arrow (the AR HUD broke for about a minute after a missed exit). Thanks to AwsomeFox
  (#21).
- **Wireless CarPlay survives a short Wi-Fi stall.** The stock CarPlay library gave up on the
  video stream after about 200 ms without a frame, and nothing restarted it. It now waits
  10 s (applied in memory; the file stays stock). Thanks to AwsomeFox (#25, #26).
- **Android Auto's maneuvers in HMG-API's log:** each one, with what went to the cluster, so
  turn reports can be checked; logged once, not every time Android Auto resends it (#22,
  #27).
- **Docs:** what makes the AR HUD animate, and the distance bar (#10).

## What to test

- Wireless CarPlay and wireless Android Auto connect, play audio and take calls.
- **CarPlay on a drive** (not tested on a drive since the beta): turns on the cluster and
  HUD, and the picture after driving through a spot with weak Wi-Fi.
- **Android Auto with the car's-own-format setting on:** a roundabout (it should go
  counterclockwise, exit on the right side), and a missed turn ("Recalculating", then the
  new route's first turn).

## Known issues

- On-ramps with the car's-own-format setting still show the projection icon, so the AR HUD
  doesn't animate at them (#30, waiting for a highway drive).
- Left-hand-traffic roundabouts (#12), keeping Bluetooth up during wireless CarPlay (#2) and
  the CarPlay picture recovery after a freeze (#3, #16) aren't in 2.2.0.
- The US Ioniq 5 (2023 on) on 260903 isn't in the mod's car list yet, so it says "isn't for
  this head unit"; install anyway works at your own risk.

## Going back

HMG-API doesn't install an older version over a newer one from the app, so: remove the mod
in the HMG-API app and apply, then put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from
[HMG-API 1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) in
`HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick and Check USB updates. Over adb, `hmgapid engine install
<zip> --force` installs it directly.

## Reporting

An [issue here](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose) with
your car, head unit software (e.g. 260507), HMG-API version and this mod's version, what
the phone and navigation app were, and a Car Report from the HMG-API app if you can.
